Method of Attack: ransomware infection disabling police surveillance computers
distribution of ransomware using police computers as proxies to attack other machines
Impacted Systems: computers used by the Washington D.C. police for surveillance
systems connected to 126 surveillance cameras monitored by the Metropolitan Police Department
Attack Vector: computer intrusion exploiting stolen e-mails, e-mail passwords, and banking credentials
Indicators of Compromise: ransom note demanding Bitcoin payment estimated at $60,800
infection with ransomware variants called 'cerber' and 'dharma'
Discoverer: law enforcement partners in the United Kingdom
Netherland’s National High Tech Crime Unit
Romanian National Police (Service for Combating Cybercrime)
FBI’s Washington, D.C. and Houston Field Offices
Office of International Affairs of the Department of Justice’s Criminal Division
